question: What did the researchers do to study how smoking affects the brain?
answer: They used resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) to look at brain connectivity changes. Participants were scanned after a 12-hour smoking abstinence period and again after smoking two cigarettes.
